name: rssmart
description: Personalized RSS news feed with Ollama classification and vote-based preference learning

scripts.postinstall: if command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec bun scripts/vendor.js; else exec node scripts/vendor.js; fi
scripts.cron: if command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec bun bin/rssmart.js cron; else exec node bin/rssmart.js cron; fi
scripts.serve: if command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec bun bin/rssmart.js serve; else exec node bin/rssmart.js serve; fi
scripts.dbstats: if command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec bun scripts/dbstats.js; else exec node scripts/dbstats.js; fi

author: Lapo Luchini <lapo@lapo.it>
